verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of an official, developer-facing SDK (client libraries, languages, or install and usage docs) that users can build against. What it does document is a Public API with an OpenAPI/swagger definition, the bw CLI and its `bw serve` local REST API, and an MCP server. These are adjacent integration surfaces and developer building blocks, not official SDKs, and community threads mention an 'SDK licensing issue' only in passing, without showing a buildable SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
